title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

title: Planning Coordinator
description:

  • Degree in engineering, logistics, inventory management, or a related field preferred.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager, LATAM & Brazil Responsável Técnico
description:
At Genesis MedTech, our quest is to make quality healthcare accessible for everyone. We believe each of us can make a positive impact at work. Together we explore ideas, innovate new solutions and make great things happen. Our culture is built on collaboration and a shared commitment to make an impact on the lives of our patients.


Position Overview

We are seeking a LATAM Regulatory Affairs Manager & Brazil Responsável Técnico (RT) to join our team. This is a critical strategic role responsible for leading the regulatory roadmap across Latin America. The successful candidate will act as the primary bridge between Global Headquarters and local markets, driving efficient market access for Class III/IV surgical devices. Additionally, this role serves as the legally designated RT for the Brazil subsidiary, with responsibility for quality compliance and legal accountability.


Key Responsibilities

1) Regional Strategic Leadership (LATAM)

  • Market Access Roadmap: Develop and execute regulatory registration strategies for key markets, including Brazil (ANVISA), Colombia (INVIMA), Mexico (COFEPRIS), Argentina (ANMAT), and Chile (ISP).
  • Regulatory Reliance: Leverage Brazil’s IN 290/2024 and similar reliance pathways in Colombia and Mexico to accelerate approvals using FDA, PMDA, or EU MDR data.
  • Distributor Oversight: Audit and manage third-party distributors across LATAM, ensuring compliance with global quality standards in storage, traceability, and post-market surveillance.
  • External Partner Management: Supervise regional regulatory consultants to ensure adherence to project timelines and technical accuracy.


2) Brazil Legal Accountability (RT Functions)

  • Statutory Responsibility: Act as the officially registered Responsável Técnico (RT) with ANVISA and the professional council (CREA).
  • QMS & BPF (GMP) Maintenance: Establish and maintain the Quality Management System in accordance with RDC 665/2022; lead ANVISA inspections and CBPF certification renewals.
  • Technical Advocacy: Manage INMETRO certification processes for active devices (e.g., robotics and energy-based systems), including coordination of technical peer reviews of international IEC 60601 reports.
  • Vigilance: Oversee the Technovigilance system, including adverse event reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCA) across the region.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Active and valid CREA (Conselho Regional de Engenharia) registration in Brazil is required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in Medical Device Regulatory Affairs, including at least 3 years in a regional LATAM leadership role.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, with professional working proficiency in Spanish.
  • Proven track record with Class III/IV (High Risk) devices. Experience with surgical robotics or energy-based surgical systems is highly preferred.
  • Experience managing MDSAP audits and ANVISA BPF certifications
  • Ability to balance commercial objectives with legal and technical independence
  • Skilled in translating complex regulations into business insights; effective in navigating the high-stakes legal environment of being a designated RT.


About Genesis MedTech

WE MAKE BETTER HEALTHCARE HAPPEN.


This is our quest: to make quality healthcare more affordable and accessible.

Headquartered in Singapore, Genesis MedTech shares a bold new world of value-based healthcare across surgical, cardiology and vascular interventional specialities.


With an open platform that brings the best of medtech together from every corner of the globe, we disrupt the inefficiencies and fragmentation that keep quality healthcare out of reach for many. Genesis MedTech aims to become the most scalable, efficient and transparent business platform for the medtech industry. At Genesis MedTech, we are also actively growing our product portfolio through R&D and innovation, acquisitions, as well as partnerships with strategic startups.

title: Able Seaman
description:
Position: Able Seaman

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Able Seaman supports deck operations, ensuring proper maintenance and operation of deck equipment, lifting appliances, and lifesaving systems. The role contributes to cargo handling, emergency preparedness, and compliance with safety and operational standards onboard.


Key Responsibilities

Inspect, test, and operate survival craft, rescue boats, and other lifesaving appliances in accordance with the maintenance plan;

Assist in material handling and lifting operations onboard;

Support housekeeping activities and waste management, including proper segregation and disposal;

Operate pedestal crane for ship-to-ship operations in the absence of the designated Crane Operator (e.g., during rest periods), subject to required qualifications;

Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment (excluding pedestal cranes);

Participate actively in emergency response activities, including fire drills, abandon ship drills, and other onboard emergency procedures;

Maintain lifeboats, liferafts, and other safety equipment in a state of readiness;

Ensure familiarity with all safety equipment and applicable procedures onboard;

Perform routine maintenance tasks such as chipping, painting, cleaning, and greasing;

Maintain deck equipment and carry out minor repairs as required.


Requirements

Valid certification as Able Seaman (in accordance with STCW requirements);

Previous offshore experience (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Experience with deck operations and lifting equipment;

Familiarity with safety procedures and emergency response onboard;

Good level of physical fitness and ability to work in offshore conditions;

Basic English communication skills (minimum intermediate level preferred);

Strong teamwork, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Medianeira - PR


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Assistente de Field
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Assegurar a continuidade e a eficiência operacional dos usuários finais, por meio do suporte técnico local, remoto e da manutenção proativa da infraestrutura de TI.

Sua missão é garantir que o hardware e o ambiente de software (incluindo o ecossistema TOTVS) funcionem sem interrupções, minimizando o tempo de inatividade e elevando os níveis de satisfação dos clientes internos, através de um atendimento ágil e resolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

1. Suporte Técnico

Atendimento Local/Remoto: Realizar o suporte técnico de Nível 1 aos usuários de forma presencial e remoto, solucionando problemas de hardware e software que podem ser resolvidos remotamente.


2. Apoio ao Ecossistema de Software (TOTVS e ERP)

● Configuração de Ambiente: Garantir que as estações de trabalho tenham os pré- requisitos necessários para rodar os sistemas TOTVS (navegadores homologados, certificados digitais, drivers de impressoras fiscais/térmicas).

● Atualização de Estações: Apoiar na atualização de pacotes e correções de software

nas máquinas dos usuários conforme as diretrizes da TI Central.


3. Gestão de Ativos e Infraestrutura

● Controle de Inventário: Manter atualizada a base de dados de ativos de TI, registrando movimentações, entradas de novos equipamentos e termos de responsabilidade.

● Organização de Estoque: Zelar pelo estoque de peças de reposição (memórias, mouses, teclados, cabos) e insumos de informática.

● Infraestrutura de Rede: Prestar apoio básico na conectividade física, como testes de pontos de rede, substituição de cabos de rede e verificação de funcionamento de switches no rack local.

● Onboarding/Desligados: Efetuar a entregar de máquinas para novos colaboradores e recolher as máquinas dos ex colaboradores.


4. Gestão de Processos e Chamados

● SLA (Acordo de Nível de Serviço): Cumprir os prazos de atendimento e solução estabelecidos, garantindo que o usuário não fique parado por longos períodos.

● Documentação Técnica: Registrar detalhadamente todas as atividades realizadas no sistema de chamados (Zendesk.), alimentando a base de conhecimento.

● Apoio em Projetos: Auxiliar na implementação de novos projetos de TI das unidades, como trocas em massa de equipamentos (rollout) ou mudanças de layout de escritório.


5. Atendimento e Experiência do Cliente

● Treinamento Básico: Orientar os usuários sobre as melhores práticas de uso dos equipamentos e segurança da informação.

● Interface com Fornecedores: Acompanhar visitas técnicas de terceiros (manutenção de ar-condicionado do CPD, links de internet ou garantia de fabricantes).

● Conhecimento em Windows 10/11, Redes (TCP/IP), Manutenção de Hardware e ferramentas Google.



O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

1. Formação Acadêmica

● Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).

● Curso Técnico ou Superior (cursando ou concluído) em áreas como: Tecnologia da

Informação, Redes de Computadores, Ciência da Computação, Análise e

Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou correlatos.

2. Conhecimentos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

● Hardware: Montagem, manutenção e diagnóstico de desktops e notebooks (substituição de peças, upgrades).

● Sistemas Operacionais: Domínio de Windows 10 e 11 (instalação, configuração e resolução de erros).

● Redes: Conhecimento básico em redes (configuração de IP, teste de cabos, conectividade Wi-Fi e entendimento de VPN).

● Pacote Office/Ferramentas Google: Suporte a Gmail, Chat, Teams, OneDrive e Word/Excel.

● Periféricos: Configuração de impressoras (locais e em rede), scanners, coletores de dados e projetores.

● Softwares de Acesso Remoto: Familiaridade com ferramentas como Logmein ou Microsoft Remote Desktop.


Requisitos desejáveis:

● Conhecimento em ERP: Familiaridade básica com a estrutura de sistemas TOTVS (Protheus, RM ou Fluig) será um grande diferencial.

● Certificações: Desejável: ITIL v4 Foundation, CompTIA A+ ou certificações Microsoft (MD-100/101).

● Inglês: Nível técnico para leitura de manuais e termos de sistemas.

● Experiência com Field Service: Já ter trabalhado com ferramentas de abertura e gestão de chamados (ex: ServiceNow, Jira, GLPI).


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

#vemserinventta

title: Analista Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico Sr - Portfólio
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêuticas da América Latina?

A Blau é uma indústria farmacêutica líder no segmento hospitalar e pioneira em biotecnologia, com portfólio proprietário de medicamentos de alta complexidade, com foco em segmentos relevantes da indústria, como imunologia, hematologia, oncologia, especialidades e antibióticos em diversas classes, entre outros.

A Blau possui footprint continental, estando presente em seis países da América Latina e nos Estados Unidos. Conta com um moderno complexo industrial farmacêutico, composto por cinco plantas industriais com tecnologia de ponta, dedicadas à produção de medicamentos biológicos, biotecnológicos, oncológicos, antibióticos, anestésicos injetáveis e insumos biotecnológicos.


Principais Responsabilidades do Cargo

• Conhecer os produtos registrados pela empresa e propor estratégias de pós-registro, visando melhoria contínua dos produtos registrados pela empresa. Realizar e revisar o levantamento bibliográfico completo, a partir de legislações vigentes, pesquisa de monografias farmacopeias, DMF`s (Drug Master File), artigos científicos e demais bibliografias para proposição de estratégia de pós-registro.

• Realizar e auxiliar na fabricação de lotes industriais na planta produtiva da empresa e em planta de terceiros, visando alterações de equipamentos, processo, formulação, alteração de local de fabricação, dentre outros, quando necessário.

• Realizar e prestar suporte na elaboração/revisão de documentos e realização de lotes piloto industriais, visando inclusão de novos fabricantes alternativos de Insumos Farmacêuticos Ativos - IFAs para obtenção de registro com dois ou mais fabricantes.

• Atuação e auxílio na transferência de tecnologias para a realização do lançamento de novos produtos, visando à implementação e estabelecimento do novo produto em linha produtiva através da realização de lotes industriais.

• Efetua e auxilia na revisão de documentos emitidos ou requeridos pela garantia da Qualidade, verificando as questões farmacotécnicas, no intuito de melhor adequar os procedimentos e fluxos já vigentes e mitigar erros de procedimentos durante a manipulação dos produtos.

• Realizar e revisar o levantamento bibliográfico completo, a partir de pesquisa de monografias farmacopeias, DMF`s (Drug Master File), artigos científicos e demais bibliografias para realização de suporte à produção, investigações e utilização do conhecimento científico para embasar reformulações de produtos.

• Realiza e presta suporte à equipe em estudo de pré-formulação e definição da melhor fórmula e processo de partida para casos de troubleshooting (solução de problemas).

• Realiza e presta suporte à equipe, na fabricação de lotes de bancada e industriais, visando à resolução de problemas encontrados na produção (melhoria de fórmula ou processos) realizando a investigação de desvios de qualidade para determinação da causa raiz do desvio.

• Realiza abertura, acompanha aprovações e executa as atividades decorrentes ao controle de mudanças (CM) e cumprimento de HMP da empresa.

• Realiza e confere suporte na avaliação de documentos e testes farmacotécnicos, visando inclusão de novos fabricantes de excipientes para obter ter dois ou mais fabricantes alternativos.

title: Técnico de Excelência Operacional Pleno
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.


As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).


Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:


A EIT Caldeiraria Ltda atua na fabricação e execução de soluções em caldeiraria industrial, atendendo demandas de produção e montagem com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e atendimento às necessidades operacionais dos clientes. Com forte interface entre engenharia e chão de fábrica, a empresa busca evoluir sua gestão produtiva para ganhar previsibilidade, produtividade e competitividade.

Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para otimizar o fluxo de trabalho na caldeiraria, aumentando a eficiência operacional e reduzindo custos e prazos de entrega. A iniciativa envolve estruturar rotinas, métodos e ferramentas de planejamento, sequenciamento e acompanhamento da produção, consolidando uma base de gestão que permita melhor tomada de decisão e maior controle sobre capacidade, materiais e prazos.

Se você tem perfil analítico e interesse em atuar diretamente na melhoria de processos e gestão da produção industrial, contribuindo para resultados mensuráveis em produtividade e entrega, venha fazer parte desse desafio.


Projeto: Implantação de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) para aumento de eficiência, redução de custos e prazos de entrega na caldeiraria industrial.


Formação Acadêmica: Engenharia da Produção com Doutorado na área.


Principais Atividades:

• Diagnóstico e mapeamento do processo produtivo;

• Estruturação de dados e parâmetros de planejamento;

• Implantação das rotinas de PCP;

• Integração com compras e gestão de materiais;

• Monitoramento de indicadores e melhoria contínua;

• Padronização, documentação e treinamento;

• PCP aplicado: noções sólidas de planejamento, sequenciamento, capacidade, lead time e estoques;

• Gestão por indicadores e melhoria contínua;


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Oracle Project Manager – Oracle ERP & Legacy Ecosystems


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across Oracle ecosystems and legacy systems . This PM is focused on managing strategic improvement programs, regulatory adaptations (including Brazilian Tax Reform), system updates, enhancements, testing cycles, and the delivery of new functionalities in enterprise environments.


The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset , with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects.


Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems .
  • Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs .
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management .
  • Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity .
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems .
  • Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.g., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts .
  • Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership .
  • Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners.
  • Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management.
  • Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers.
  • Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements.


Desired Profile

  • Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership .
